title: Competitor Mapping
prompt:
Act as a competitive intelligence analyst.
My business        :  [WHAT YOU DO AND WHO YOU SERVE]
Key competitors :  [LIST 5–8 DIRECT AND INDIRECT]
Map each competitor across these dimensions:
Price positioning (budget / mid / premium)
Target customer (SMB / mid-market / enterprise)
Core strength (what they are known for)
Core weakness (where they are consistently criticised)
Key differentiator (what makes them choose-able)
After mapping :
1. Where is the market most crowded?
2. What white space exists that no competitor occupies?
3. Where am I most vulnerable to competitive pressure?
4. What is the one thing I must own to be clearly different?

PRO TIP
The most valuable output is not the map itself,  it is the white space analysis. Ask AI
specifically: 'Given this competitive map, describe the customer who is currently
underserved by every player in this market.' That customer is your Blue Ocean
opportunity.
